newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mineral/energy exports to rise in 97/98-ABARE.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mineral/energy exports to rise in 97/98-ABARE.

text.p: Australian export volumes of energy and mineral commodities are forecast to rise 10.5 percent to A$39.8 billion in 1997/98 after rising seven percent in 1996/97 (July-June), the government's chief forecaster said on Tuesday.

Capital investment in Australia's mining sector should reach a record high, as miners respond to strong growth in Asian demand, the Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics (ABARE) said in a paper scheduled for delivery at the start of its annual commodities industry conference here.
The value of Australian energy and mineral exports in 1996/97 is forecast at a record A$36 billion, ABARE also said.
Earnings from these exports are projected to rise 22 percent or by A$7.8 billion from 1996/97 levels to A$43.8 billion in the year 2001/02, ABARE figures show.
But increasing supplies would pressure commodities prices on a global scale, meaning Australian producers must improve efficiencies to remain competitive, ABARE said.
